span.label: The paper's central claim is that three specific skills - AI literacy, prompt engineering knowledge and critical thinking - are what schools need to remedy the problems AI creates in education.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the author's own trial, GPT-3.5 answered a lost-object reasoning task incorrectly under plain input-output prompting but correctly under Tree-of-Thought prompting.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The case-study university settled on a middle-ground policy in which student use of ChatGPT and other LLMs is neither banned nor left unrestricted.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Requiring students to document how they critically evaluated the AI's output was the element of the guidelines the authors considered novel relative to other institutions.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The written AI guidelines are undermined because they work only if students voluntarily read and follow them, and compliance cannot be verified.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The main barrier to teachers adopting AI tools in class is fear rooted in not knowing enough about the technology and expecting to use it wrongly.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A year after ChatGPT's release, almost all students in the case-study classrooms had already used it.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The institution has nobody formally responsible for tracking AI developments, leaving it to individual staff on their own time.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The university offers no workshops or training programmes to raise teacher or student competence with AI.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
